# Third-party offline dependencies

- p5.js 1.11.3 — GNU LGPL 2.1, <https://p5js.org/>
- ml5.js 1.0.1 — MIT License, <https://ml5js.org/>
- MediaPipe Hands 0.4.1675469240 — Apache License 2.0, <https://developers.google.com/mediapipe>
- Cormorant Garamond — SIL Open Font License 1.1
- IBM Plex Mono — SIL Open Font License 1.1

These files are stored locally so the artwork can run without a network connection.
